short_description: An industrial-components maker's Dayton plant is about to run out of gear-housing castings: SG-400 demand is up 46% and a Yantian port delay rolled its sole supplier's containers. An S&OP planner console (Databricks App on Lakebase) forecasts demand with AI_FORECAST, explodes the BOM, projects 13 weeks of inventory, reads supplier emails with ai_extract, prices every mitigation (inter-plant transfer of E&O stock, alternate foundry, air expedite, safety stock), and a copilot stages the cheapest plan with policy citations (the Genie agent over the documents) for the planner to book — written back to Delta for the AI/BI dashboard and Genie.
